items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and boy am I pleased to have Lorraine Feather with me this morning. Welcome. Thanks for your time. [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk, for inviting me.

ctx.x: Lorraine was interviewed via Zoom on March 22, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
